# Catamenia

> Free, private period tracker web app (PWA). Records periods (pain level, flow, notes) and forecasts the next periods with an 80 % uncertainty range, warns when a period is overdue and creates a PDF report for the doctor. All data stays on the device: no server, no account, no cookies, no ads, no tracking (only an optional one-time install counter with explicit consent). Languages: German, English, Polish, Turkish, Ukrainian. Not a medical device, not for contraception.

App: https://oxi75.github.io/catamenia/
Author: Oxi75 · License: PolyForm Strict 1.0.0 (noncommercial use; source code not public)

## Key facts

- Platform: web app, installable on iPhone (Safari → Add to Home Screen), Android and desktop; works offline.
- Recording: per day period with pain (none/light/medium/strong), optional flow (light/normal/heavy), "period over", note; further complaints (e.g. PMS, after the DRSP symptom groups) with overall severity; discharge (clear/milky, kept out of the PMS evaluation); retroactive entries.
- Forecast: robust weighted statistics of own cycles (recent cycles weigh more, outliers damped via median/MAD), blended with prior values while data is scarce; k-th period spread √(k·σ² + (k·se)²); 80 % ranges; overdue warning; per-day probability shading in the calendar.
- Doctor's report: PDF on the device, 3/6/12/all cycles, report language independent of app language, key figures, pain/flow chart per cycle, table of all entries; share (e.g. Mail) or save.
- Backup: JSON export (optionally password-encrypted), reminder after an adjustable interval (default 30 days, 0 = off); smart import that merges compatible data and warns about contradictions (same-day conflicts, implausibly short cycles, shifted periods, different cycle patterns).
- Privacy: data only in browser storage (IndexedDB); leaves the device only when the user exports or shares.
